verses.text: The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, I will bring yet one more plague on Faraon, and on Egipt; afterwards he will let you să plece. When he lets you să plece, he will surely thrust you out altogether.
Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of să pleceld.
The DOMNUL gave the people favor in the sight of the Egiptians. Moreover, the man Moise was very great in the țară of Egipt, in the sight of Faraon’s servants, and in the sight of the people.
Moise a zis, This is what the DOMNUL says: ‘About midnight I will să plece out into the middle of Egipt,

and all the firstborn in the țară of Egipt shall die, from the firstborn of Faraon who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.
There will be a great cry throughout all the țară of Egipt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that the DOMNUL makes a distinction between the Egiptians and Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, Get out, with all the people who follow you; and after that I will să plece out.’  He went out from Faraon in hot anger.
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Faraon won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the țară of Egipt.
Moise and Aaron did all these wonders before Faraon, but the DOMNUL hardened Faraon’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel să plece out of his țară.
